BOOT_HEIGHT_DEFAULT_MM.doc: Tunnel boot height (top of the boot deck above the floor) when the params give none. Bedroom Style 3 measures 398; the east-west bedroom 418.

WARDROBE_WIDTH_DEFAULT_MM.doc: Wardrobe width from the van's side wall to its inner face (the opening edge) when the params give none. Same on both sides: the north-south bedroom is symmetric by rule.

OHC_BOTTOM_DEFAULT_MM.doc: Door underside of the middle overhead above the floor when the params give none. The bottom panel sits OHC_DOOR_DROP_MM above this. Style 3 measures 1418.

BOOT_DECK_THICKNESS_MM.doc: Tunnel boot deck (the board the wardrobes and the mattress sit on): 18 mm structural stock, wall to wall and the full depth of the body. Style 3 measures 18.

WARDROBE_WIDTH_MIN_MM.doc: Narrowest wardrobe allowed (from the side wall).

OPENING_HEIGHT_MIN_MM.doc: Least clear height between the boot deck and the overhead underside — room for the mattress and to sit up.

OHC_HEIGHT_MIN_MM.doc: Least overhead block height under the lowest roof over the body.

BED_FRAME_QUEEN_WIDTH_MM.doc: Outer width of the queen bed frame / bed box. A product size, not a design number: the opening between the wardrobes must be at least this wide and the bed box is exactly this wide. Style 3 measures 1508 (side panel outer faces).

DOOR_PANEL_THICKNESS_DEFAULT_MM.doc: Wardrobe colour panel (door stock) thickness when the params give none.

WARDROBE_T2_BACK_MM.doc: Y from the room face to the back of T2 — the one fixed distance of the wardrobe top. The colour panel runs full height (to the roof) from here toward the nose; in front of it the panel is cut down to the T3 seat. Style 3: 66.

WARDROBE_T2_THICKNESS_MM.doc: T2 (rear top rail) thickness; it stands on T3 with its back at WARDROBE_T2_BACK.

WARDROBE_T2_HEIGHT_MM.doc: T2 height at its back, measured to the roof there. Sets the T3 seat: T3 top = roof(T2 back) − this − T3 clearance. The roof slopes, so T2 is taller at its front (Style 3: 35 back, 38 front).

WARDROBE_T1_THICKNESS_MM.doc: T1 (front top rail) thickness; it stands on T3 directly in front of T2.

WARDROBE_T1_OVERSIZE_MM.doc: T1 is cut this much taller than the roof at its back (a flat top: the three-axis router cannot cut the slope) — trimmed to the roof on site.

WARDROBE_T3_THICKNESS_MM.doc: T3 (top panel over the wardrobe) thickness.

WARDROBE_T3_CLEARANCE_MM.doc: Clearance between T3 top and the T1 / T2 undersides, and above T3 in the colour panel's pocket.

WARDROBE_T3_DEPTH_MM.doc: T3 depth from the room face toward the nose.

WARDROBE_T3_LIP_DEPTH_MM.doc: Pocket in the colour panel behind the T2 back (Y from WARDROBE_T2_BACK) that T3's tail slides into; its height is T3 + clearance.

WARDROBE_T3_TAIL_CLEARANCE_MM.doc: T3's tail stops this short of the pocket end. Beyond the tail T3 is notched back to the colour panel's wall-side face.

WARDROBE_PANEL_MIN_HEIGHT_MM.doc: Least colour-panel height between the boot deck and the T3 seat.

WARDROBE_WALL_STRIP_DEPTH_MM.doc: Wall strip depth from the room face. Carcass, against the side wall, one each side. The front profile matches the colour panel (seat, pocket, roof); the board stops here instead of running to the nose. Bottom is the boot deck. Style 3 measures 175.

WARDROBE_SHELF_ABOVE_FLOOR_MM.doc: Style 1 wardrobe shelf underside above the wardrobe floor (boot + 197). Bedroom 1: floor 615, shelf 625. Not the fixed-panel split.

WARDROBE_SHELF_STRIP_SETBACK_MM.doc: From the room face, the shelf stays clear of the wall strip. Past this it runs to the wall, through a notch in the strip. Bedroom 1 measures 75.

WARDROBE_SHELF_STRIP_GAP_MM.doc: Gap between the shelf and the wall strip's inner face over that front setback.

WARDROBE_SHELF_TONGUE_TIP_MM.doc: Shelf tongue into the colour panel stops this short of the panel's mid-thickness (tongue = door thickness / 2 − this). Bedroom 1: 7.5 into the 16 mm panel.

WARDROBE_SHELF_GROOVE_EXTRA_MM.doc: Colour-panel groove is this much deeper than the tongue. Not through the panel.

WARDROBE_SHELF_GROOVE_Z_MM.doc: Groove / strip notch is this much taller than the shelf on each side (slot = shelf + 1).

WARDROBE_SHELF_GROOVE_END_MM.doc: Groove runs this much past the tongue at each end, along the depth. Tongue sits in the middle third of the body depth.

WARDROBE_FLOOR_RAISE_MM.doc: Wardrobe floor top above the boot deck (Style 3 / Bedroom 1: kick + floor = 197). The Style 1 fixed panel sits on this.

WARDROBE_DOOR_CLEARANCE_MM.doc: Reveal around the wardrobe door: wall-side gap, and the vertical gap between the Style 1 fixed panel and the door. Opening side is flush with the colour panel.

WARDROBE_FIXED_PANEL_TOP_DEFAULT_MM.doc: Style 1: top of the fixed panel (the dragged split) when the params give none. Bedroom 1 measures 775; the door starts this + clearance above it.

WARDROBE_FIXED_PANEL_MIN_MM.doc: Least Style 1 fixed-panel height (floor top → split).

WARDROBE_DOOR_MIN_MM.doc: Least Style 1 door height (split + clearance → T3 top). Leaves room for three hinge cups 100 from each end.

WARDROBE_HINGE_DIAMETER_MM.doc: Wardrobe door hinge cup diameter. Bedroom 1 / Style 3 measure 35.

WARDROBE_HINGE_DEPTH_MM.doc: Wardrobe door hinge cup depth, from the inside face.

WARDROBE_HINGE_FROM_END_MM.doc: Cup centre from the door top and from the door bottom; the third cup is midway.

WARDROBE_HINGE_FROM_SIDE_MM.doc: Cup centre from the door's hinge (wall-side) edge. Bedroom 1 measures 22.5 — a standard 35 mm full-overlay cup. The mounting plate on the wall strip comes later.

OHC_DOOR_DROP_MM.doc: Middle overhead: the up-flap underside (ohcBottom) is this far below the bottom panel. Same drop as the wall overhead.

OHC_BP_OVERSIZE_MM.doc: Bottom panel is cut this much deeper than the uprights, past where the roof meets the panel's top face. The slope cannot be cut on a three-axis router — trim to the roof on the sliding table saw. Same idea as T1's oversize.

OHC_FEATURE_CLEARANCE_MM.doc: Extra width of a bottom-panel groove or a T3 notch over the upright thickness (slot = panel + this). Matches the wall overhead.

OHC_T3_NOTCH_DEPTH_MM.doc: How far the middle T3's rear edge is notched to clear each of this cabinet's own uprights (D0, internal D, DN). Matches the wall overhead T3 notch. Not shared with the wardrobe T3s.

OHC_FRONT_CLEARANCE_MM.doc: Gap between neighbouring overhead doors, and at the outer edges of the run. Matches the wall overhead.

OHC_HINGE_FROM_TOP_MM.doc: Up-flap cup centre down from the door top. Two cups, both at this height.

OHC_HINGE_FROM_SIDE_2_MM.doc: Two bays: cup centre from the outer face of each side panel, and from the centre divider's centreline.

OHC_HINGE_FROM_SIDE_3_MM.doc: Three bays: cup centre from each side edge of the door. The wall overhead's rule.

OHC_ZONE_MIN_MM.doc: Narrowest overhead bay (centreline to centreline, including the end panels).

OHC_ZONE_COUNT_DEFAULT.doc: Overhead bays when the params give none. Two or three, up flaps only; two is the Style 3 split.
